name: Catawba County, NC
findings: Catawba County has 383 nonprofit organizations. 160 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 130 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Catawba County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Education organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 15 education organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
